name: adoption
wording: of the workflow on a project that already has work: the architect drafts the conceptual model from the operator's statement of purpose, weighing earlier records and the product's screens, interfaces and documents as evidence, never as the design; reads it back, corrects it in place until first committed, removing the earlier record in that commit; leads then review the delivered work against it, a review changing nothing and needing no story, and user stories and tasks follow
reason: The operator: each concept is an address plus a correction: the most precise established name as read within its bounded context, and a residue holding only the symmetric difference, its relations each stated once where owned, in the dense form of the canon's own values; the earlier restatement put the name before prose restating what the name already invokes, kept episodes and missed established names.
